items.raw_excerpt: A small church in Uppsala hides the grave of a renowned 18th-century astronomer.
items.summary_en: In Uppsala, Sweden, a small church holds the grave of Anders Celsius. He was an 18th-century astronomer known for the Celsius temperature scale. The grave is easy to miss and quiet to visit.

items.title_en: A Quiet Church Grave in Uppsala Holds a Famous Astronomer

items.raw_excerpt: Lonely Planet adds Spanish city of León to 2027 global must-visit list, website selling Spain-England football tickets hacked, Spanish PM slams housing crisis 'tragedy' after pensioner evicted and more news on Thursday September 24th.

items.summary_en: Health New Zealand has paused new patient admissions at Dannevirke Community Hospital. The hospital needs more clinical staff after several staff members resigned. It is still caring for patients who are already there.

items.raw_excerpt: As the weather turns crisp and leaves scatter the streets, you might find yourself dreaming about spending a day in a cozy little village. Ontario has no shortage of quaint small towns, but this charm...
items.summary_en: A small village in Ontario has stone shops and cozy cafes that feel like the Cotswolds in England. The writer invites readers to spend a quiet day walking its streets on a crisp autumn day. It is an easy day trip for anyone who lives nearby.

items.raw_excerpt: Thirty thousand sterile male mosquitoes will be released on 24 September in the Lisbon parish of Alvalade, in the first phase of an experimental project to reduce the population of the Asian tiger mosquito, one official told the Lusa news agency.
items.summary_en: Lisbon will release 30,000 sterile male mosquitoes in the Alvalade area on 24 September. The goal is to reduce the number of Asian tiger mosquitoes. Officials say the project is a first test of the method.

items.raw_excerpt: Kabaddi has its roots in ancient rural communities in South Asia and India is the superpower, but Japan has developed a niche taste for the team contact sport -- thanks to a comic. At a gymnasium on the outskirts of the port city of Nagoya, hosts Japan face another unlikely…

items.raw_excerpt: A spiritual group based in northern NSW has rejected claims it is liable to repay loans from a former follower who is suing for $2.55 million.
items.summary_en: A spiritual group in northern New South Wales says it does not owe money to a former follower. The man is suing the group for 2.55 million dollars. The court heard that the group used his loans for a luxury trip and property.

items.raw_excerpt: A new survey points to severe time pressure, poor workplace communication, and economic uncertainty as the key factors.
items.summary_en: A new survey asked workers in many jobs about stress at work. Most said they have a lot to do and not enough time. Bad talking with bosses and worry about money make the stress worse.

items.raw_excerpt: Asian communities nationwide are marking mid-autumn celebrations in their own ways.
items.summary_en: Asian communities across New Zealand are holding their own Mid-Autumn Festival events this spring. Families and neighbours share food, lanterns and moon watching with their local communities. Each group keeps its own traditions, from Chinese to Korean and Vietnamese celebrations.

items.raw_excerpt: Infraestruturas de Portugal (IP) will build a new viaduct over the railway line to connect the Garraia area to National Road (EN) 18 on the outskirts of Évora, representing an investment of €2.2 million.
items.summary_en: Portugal will build a new viaduct near Evora in the Alentejo region. The road bridge will cross the railway line and link the Garraia area to National Road 18. The project costs 2.2 million euros.

items.raw_excerpt: Explore Thiruvananthapuram's vibrant riding communities uniting vintage enthusiasts and new riders through shared passion for two-wheelers.
items.summary_en: Riders in Thiruvananthapuram gathered to show off old and new two-wheelers. Vintage Vespa fans and Royal Enfield owners share the same love for motorcycles. The meet-up brought different riding groups together in one friendly place.

items.raw_excerpt: Before vast numbers were felled to build the villas of Ponsonby and Grey Lynn for early European settlers, Auckland's Waitakere Ranges were covered in ancient kauri forests.
items.summary_en: Auckland's Waitakere Ranges were once covered with ancient kauri forests. Now a disease called kauri dieback is killing the remaining trees. Scientists and local volunteers say a new treatment may help the trees survive.
